label: Whatever causes a quality in another thing is more such than that thing
paraphrase: Whatever causes a quality in another thing is more such than that thing (the cause of another's heat is hotter). Stated without a synonymy condition by Posterior Analytics I.2, 72a29-30 (always, that because of which each thing belongs itself belongs more; claim ARIST-APOST-72A-CAUSE-MORE-SUCH). It is a strengthening of Metaphysics II.1, 993b24-26, which says it only of that in virtue of which the synonymous quality belongs to the others: the formal reading also covers causes that do not have the quality in the same sense.
